versions.changelog:
- Clarified that all queries are executed via local Python scripts bundled within the skill; direct API calls or CLI tools (hcloud, openstack, curl, etc.) are strictly prohibited.
- Added step-by-step usage instructions including mandatory environment check procedures before running any resource queries.
- Updated prerequisites to clearly specify required environment variables and their roles.
- Provided detailed execution flow, emphasizing the importance of using guide.md for correct script names/parameters and not reading script source code directly.
- Outlined the directory structure and conventions to ensure users follow the intended workflow.
- Reiterated strict read-only operation—no write actions are supported.
